blocks.text: Actor Dingdong Dantes condemned mockery and reminded public figures of the responsibility that comes with having a platform. Dantes posed the reminder on his Facebook page on Thursday, Oct. 15. While he did not name anyone in his post, it was shared amid the backlash against the hosts of the Machong Chismoso podcast over their disparaging remarks about Kris Aquino’s son, Josh Aquino, who is on the autism spectrum. “Ang mikropono at entablado ay may kaakibat na pananagutan,” Dantes said. “Hindi aliw ang panghahamak. Tungkulin nating itaas ang pamantayan, hindi lang ang volume.” Dantes had netizens nodding in agreement, with several […]...
